question: On which lunar occasion must fasting be observed according to this instruction?
premises: It belongs to the bright fortnight.
Fasting is prescribed on that occasion.
inference: One must fast on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight.
uncertainties: The sentence continues in the next verse, so the full injunction is incomplete here.
plain_english: On the twelfth day of the bright fortnight, having fasted, O my beautiful one.
